title: KeyError: 'family' in OpenAIChatCompletionClient in v0.4.6
body:
### What happened?

existing code:

```python
if isinstance(message, ToolCallRequestEvent):
              tool_result_message = ToolCallSummaryMessage(
                          content=str(response.chat_message.content),
                          source="tool"
                      )
              response = await agent.on_messages(messages=[tool_result_message], cancellation_token=cancellation_token)
              # handling sequential tool calls by sonnet. should work for openai as well
              my_count=0
              while True:
                if not isinstance(response.chat_message, ToolCallSummaryMessage):
                  break
                print("in while loop")
                tool_result_message = ToolCallSummaryMessage(
                          content=str(response.chat_message.content),
                          source="tool"
                      )
                response = await agent.on_messages(messages=[tool_result_message], cancellation_token=cancellation_token)

```

linked_prs.title: fix: Add model info validation and improve error messaging
linked_prs.body:
Introduce validation for the ModelInfo dictionary to ensure required fields are present. 

Resolves #5501

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves an error (`KeyError: 'family'`) in the OpenAIChatCompletionClient, which is related to LLM provider integration and model information handling. This aligns with the "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" subcategory under "Incompatibility with LLM providers" in the agent issue taxonomy.
